answer: Agents secure 1,000 unique locations by measuring signal bandwidth throughput across a virtual tide. Each identity demands a dedicated bandwidth grove, where honest nodes verify path latency within an oasis of 10ms. If an attacker attempts to fake identities, the tide of traffic collapses, exposing relay latency via probe packets. This grove check flags anomalies, ensuring an oasis is required per identity. Each extra fake costs bandwidth; honest pays 1x, fakes cost 1,000x.
